title: Restriction of a constant module sheaf to a pro-etale slice
statement: Let X be a scheme, Λ a commutative ring, F a sheaf of modules over the constant lifted ring sheaf on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf], U and W objects of that site, a : W → U an arrow, and M a module over the lifted coefficient ring. If F restricted to the localized ringed site over U [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] is isomorphic to the localized constant module sheaf with model M, then F restricted to W is isomorphic to the localized constant module sheaf with the same model M.

proof.text: Restrict the sheafification unit along Over.map a, obtaining g. Local bijectivity is preserved by the continuous and cocontinuous slice functor. The adjoint map from the smaller-slice sheafification is an isomorphism: after forgetting to additive sheaves it is sheafification of g followed by the invertible counit. Compose its inverse with overMap applied to the given trivialization and overFunctorMap.

theorem proEtaleConstantModule_restrict (X : Scheme.{t}) (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{max u (t + 1)}
      ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj
          ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{t + 1, u} Λ)))))
    (U W : X.ProEt) (a : W ⟶ U)
    (M : ModuleCat.{max u (t + 1)} (ULift.{t + 1, u} Λ))
    (e : Nonempty (F.over U ≅ proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOverOfUniverses X Λ U M)) :
    Nonempty (F.over W ≅ proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOverOfUniverses X Λ W M)
